note: Issue #882: how a planet's speeder roads look (src/systems/world/road_network.gd; the roads themselves are data in the planet file's `roads` block). The strip is packed dirt a hand over the sand, darker than the dunes, drawn near only (draw_m, in chunk_m pieces each culled on its own); it never changes the ground. A lamp is a thin post with a glowing head (glow only, no real light): the heads of a whole road are one MultiMesh drawn far (glow_draw_m), so a far road reads as a dotted line of lights, the posts another drawn near (post_draw_m).
